propositions: The Cloud comment differ's body-equality dedup key is fitted with truncate_comment_body (plain 32,767 char cap) while the send path fits with AdfCodec.fit_outbound (serialized ADF 32,000 limit plus marker budget), so keys diverge for over-length comments and can never match on the secondary body-equality skip.

For a 43,200-char body on current main, the compare key yields 32,767 chars while the landed body is 31,753 chars, with first divergence at index 31,725, proving structural mismatch in the regime where ADF serialization crosses its budget around plain length 31.8k.

The divergence was introduced when commit 27b868ba55 moved the send path off the shared truncate_comment_body helper to codec.fit_outbound while leaving the differ on truncate_comment_body, and the subsequent demotion of body-equality to secondary skip removed the guard that would have caught this.

The compare key computation is in-memory and never persisted (binding_store stores only comment id mappings), so retargeting the key to match the landed body cannot cause re-posts and no key migration is required.

A test must assert that for an over-length comment the differ's fit_comment result equals the text actually landed by the send path, and this test must be red on the pre-fix code to prove the regression.
